import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(s);

        // Replace first occurrence of "at" starting from index 1 with "@"
        int atIndex = sb.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (atIndex != -1) {
            sb.replace(atIndex, atIndex + 2, "@");
        }

        // Replace "dot" starting from index 1, but not if it would be at the end
        while (true) {
            int dotIndex = sb.indexOf("dot", 1);
            if (dotIndex == -1 || dotIndex > sb.length() - 4) {
                break;
            }
            sb.replace(dotIndex, dotIndex + 3, ".");
        }

        System.out.println(sb.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
